OPTION_MC_COOK.name: Cook
OPTION_MC_COOK.description: Select 2-4 [gold]Spire Delight[/gold] cards to cook. You will receive a relic based on their cooking stats (selected cards are removed).
OPTION_MC_COOK.descriptionDisabled: [red]You need at least 2 Spire Delight cards in your deck to cook. [/red]
OPTION_MC_COOK_FOOD.name: Cook Ingredient
OPTION_MC_COOK_FOOD.description: Select 1 [gold]Spire Delight[/gold] raw ingredient card to cook. It is converted into its cooked version (the selected card is removed).
OPTION_MC_COOK_FOOD.descriptionDisabled: [red]You need at least 1 cookable raw ingredient card in your deck. [/red]
